text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just before the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! This is literally our only plan for 
Christmas this year, so get it together, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summoned by Daiwa Scarlet, I came out to 
the city center illuminated by sparkling 
lights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The objective was—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, a shooting star! Look!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The clash of the century held at Nakayama 
Racecourse! Who will become this year's 
strongest Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place in the fan vote is Daiwa 
Scarlet! What is the sight the Scarlet 
Queen yearns for—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—This is a special 'Arima Kinen' 
commercial that only airs in this town 
today."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...The favorite, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Things like that were left behind a 
long, long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to run on Arima's turf soon. And 
dash through ahead of everyone gathered 
there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to become number one—the one who 
stays in everyone's memories.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that's right. I know I can do 
it."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I don't really have anything 
else to do. Time to head back to the 
academy...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, wanna drop by the flower shop?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's only natural for the victorious 
Umamusume to be presented with flowers, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So I figured I'd let you know in advance 
what kind of flowers you should give me.
choice_data_list: You want me to get it ready?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. Who else besides you would 
prepare it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, just kidding. Well, I won't get 
my hopes up while waiting.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the flower I like is called 
magnolia. It's white and really pretty.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come spring, they bloom towards the sky. 
High, so high, reaching for the very peak 
of the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't that sound just like me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And tagging along with Daiwa Scarlet, I 
spent that day admiring her favorite 
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's a scarf. It's been getting quite a 
bit colder lately, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I chose one with fairly good heat 
retention. ...Make sure you actually use 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: C-O-L-D P-R-E-V-E-N-T-I-O-N, got it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because on the day of the race, having it 
announced that 'The trainer is absent due 
to poor health' would be utterly 
disgraceful."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even though I went through the trouble of 
taking 1st place in the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, that would be a big help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Daiwa Scarlet gave it to me, I 
decided to put the muffler to use right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps because of that, the journey 
home felt remarkably warm."
